name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: M6.7 quake in Peru's central Andes on 21 Nov rated PAGER green; no M7+ in the past week
state: USGS recorded an M6.7 earthquake 9km north-east of Carhuamayo in Peru's central Andes at 00:09 UTC on 21 Nov, rated PAGER green. It and an M6.6 west-south-west of Tual, Indonesia, on 16 Nov and an M6.0 on the Pacific-Antarctic Ridge on 18 Nov were the only M6+ events in seven days, all green (USGS). No M7+ or PAGER orange alert, so Normal holds.
for_you: Follow Peru's civil defence (INDECI) and FCDO advice if in the affected area.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.8 below the 7 Watch line

sources.title: USGS — M6.7, 9 km NE of Carhuamayo, Peru
USGS — M6.6, 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
